value: Run local dev over HTTPS to match production cookie/auth behavior

value: Durable human-in-the-loop workflows without extra orchestration stack

comparisons: vs Temporal: Vercel removes the container and checkpoint database, while Temporal is used when teams hold state in memory

vs dedicated engine: Vercel Workflows is not the right choice for coordinating Java services or BPMN models as first-class actors

vs HTTP+SSE: `sse` is deprecated and client support is optional

value: Vercel can replace much of a self-hosted eval stack while keeping orchestration, tracing, and storage manageable.

limitations: AI Gateway keys have no per-key rate limits or model allowlists like LiteLLM virtual keys.
AI Gateway zero data retention excludes certain models; those requests proceed without a ZDR guarantee.

Custom Reporting is in beta; tag writes and report queries are billed; report API requires Pro or Enterprise; report data covers the whole account during beta; tags are limited to 10 per request; report queries are account-wide during beta, not per-client isolated by default.
comparisons: vs LiteLLM: AI Gateway covers unified API access, ordered fallback, key management, spend tracking, and request logging, but lacks load-aware routing and LiteLLM-style per-key rate limits/model allowlists.

vs self-hosted stack: Vercel can replace three deployed services (LiteLLM, Langfuse, and the database behind them), but you still need your own app logic for grading, data modeling, and eval-native concepts.

value: Build agents with one API, safer execution, chat reach, and durable workflows.

comparisons: vs direct provider access: AI Gateway keeps the application code the same across providers and charges tokens at provider-direct cost, with no markup.

vs your own infrastructure: running model-generated code there is risky because it might consume excessive resources, read sensitive files, make unwanted network requests, or run destructive commands.
vs a plain request without failover: with gateway fallbacks, the first successful model response is returned automatically without application logic changes.

value: Capture request-level AI usage, cost, and failures in one queryable row.

vs AI SDK telemetry with an OpenTelemetry exporter: `evlog/ai` adds request-level fields for questions across requests, such as which route or customer uses the most tokens
vs tail sampling: use evlog tail sampling to keep every failed or expensive request while sampling routine ones

value: Shows the platform and app-layer constraints that shape secure auth on Vercel

vs Edge Runtime: Next.js 16 proxy.ts runs on Node.js instead, and Edge is unavailable there.

vs Cloudflare Workers: Vercel supports ISR with `adapter: vercel({ isr: true })`, while Webflow Cloud does not offer ISR.
